reply:
Because `streamObject` validates the entire object, using strict `lat`/`lng` bounds in the Zod schema would cause an entire itinerary to be rejected over a single bad number. Filtering coordinates at render time in `ItineraryView` keeps failures local, resulting in a single missing map pin instead of an empty screen.

(Sources: resume, AI Travel Planner README)

steps.summary: AI Travel Planner coordinates render Zod schema in ai-travel-planner
